newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut says sets $162 mln bond sale for Wed..
newsitem.headline: Connecticut says sets $162 mln bond sale for Wed..

text.p: Connecticut scheduled the sale of nearly $162 million of tax-exempt general obligation bonds for Wednesday, the state Treasurer's office said on Tuesday.

Asked when the sale would occur, an official with the state Treasurer's office replied "Tomorrow." She added "We have a schedule to get off between now and early December, and this is just the way it fell."

The state official, who declined to be named, added that the retail order period started on Friday, saying that while it was going "okay," she had no precise details about the amount of orders that had been received so far.
The negotiated offering is being senior-managed by Merrill Lynch & Co.
